#!/bin/bash
#FLUX: --output=/scratch/gilbreth/gupt1075/infer_fourcastnet_nov.out
#FLUX: --error=/scratch/gilbreth/gupt1075/infer_fourcastnet_nov.err
#FLUX: --nodes=1
#FLUX: --ntasks-per-node=32
#FLUX: --gpus-per-job=1
#FLUX: --time=1:00:00
#FLUX: --job-name=fourcastnet_job
# The SLURM -A (account) and -C (constraint) directives with OR logic do not have a direct translation in Flux.
# Original SLURM: #SBATCH -A gdsp-k|standby
# Original SLURM: #SBATCH -C "v100|a100|a30"
# Omission of these constraints may impact job scheduling, resource selection, and accounting. You may need to submit to a specific queue that contains the desired resources.

# change the directory path of model run-time output and error messages to your own
# The file name of this submission file, so it's easier to track jobs
# filename: submit_run_model_example.sub
# partner queue has a 24-hour limit
# Job name, it will show up when you track this job
# Use your email address so that you will receive email notifications about the job begin, end, or fail status
# To submit the job via command line:$  flux submit ./your_script_name.sh 
# To check status of the submitted job:$  flux jobs -u yourUserID

module --force purge
unset PYTHONPATH
module load anaconda/5.3.1-py37
module load cuda/11.7.0
module load cudnn/cuda-11.7_8.6
module use /depot/gdsp/etc/modules
module load utilities monitor
module load rcac

module list
export PRECXX11ABI=1
export CUDA="11.7"

echo $PYTHONPATH

echo "$now"
echo "Current date completed loading modules: $now"

# # track per-code GPU load
# monitor gpu percent --all-cores >gpu-percent.log &
# GPU_PID=$!


# # track memory usage
# monitor gpu memory >gpu-memory.log &
# MEM_PID=$!


# # track per-code CPU load
# monitor cpu percent --all-cores >cpu-percent.log &
# CPU_PID=$!

# # track memory usage
# monitor cpu memory >cpu-memory.log &
# MEM_PID=$!




# Loading anaconda environment
source  /apps/spack/gilbreth/apps/anaconda/5.3.1-py37-gcc-4.8.5-7vvmykn/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate pytorch


# Change this directory to where you save the model-related files such as run_model.py
# cd /scratch/gilbreth/wwtung/FourCastNet/

python /scratch/gilbreth/gupt1075/FourCastNet_gil/inference/inference.py \
       --config="afno_backbone" \
       --run_num="222" \
       --fld="z500" \
       --weights="/scratch/gilbreth/wwtung/FourCastNet/model_weights/FCN_weights_v0/backbone.ckpt"  \
       --exp_dir="/scratch/gilbreth/gupt1075/ERA5_expts_tutorial/"

issues: The variable '$now' is used in two 'echo' commands but is never defined within the script. This will result in printing an empty string.

The commented-out monitoring section contains a bug where the variable 'MEM_PID' is assigned twice. If uncommented, the process ID for the 'monitor gpu memory' command would be overwritten by the 'monitor cpu memory' command.

The script relies on hardcoded absolute paths for executables, source files, and directories (e.g., '/apps/spack/gilbreth/...', '/scratch/gilbreth/...'). This makes the script specific to this system and user, reducing portability.
